title: Weltline Penny Loafers - Tan Calf
description: Classic full strap penny loafer, when the occasion calls for something more refined than a beefroll. Handcrafted from burnished calfskin and fully lined with our tan calfskin lining. Double leather soles and leather keyed heel. Genuine Handsewn moccasin construction. Made in Maine, USA.
